checkpoints.description: [1/4] Plan: validate stored policy/workspace digests and add the workspace pin

impact_assessment.why: The episode verifier accepted any non-empty policy string and ignored the stored workspace digest, so a malformed policy was recomputed and the source-tree evidence was never checked.
impact_assessment.benefits: Stored policy/workspace must be 64-hex; an optional expected workspace pin rejects a wrong or missing tree; claim verification passes both pins through.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: verifier kwargs only, header unchanged; dependency: workspace_digest for callers; concurrency: read-only; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Validate both expected digests, require verify_episodes for claim pins, keep None as old behavior; test current/wrong/missing/invalid and claims; run 430 tests and AIKit.

[1/4] Plan: optional HMAC-SHA256 for claim-store snapshots

impact_assessment.why: A rewritten claims payload with a recomputed checksum passed; the store boundary was checksum-only.
impact_assessment.benefits: A caller-held key authenticates the snapshot including its checksum; wrong/missing MACs fail while the valid primary is preserved.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: optional store kwargs, schema gains optional mac; dependency: stdlib hmac; concurrency: unchanged lock; state: optional field.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Exclude mac from the checksum, keep unkeyed snapshots byte-compatible, do not quarantine on MAC errors; test keyed/wrong/missing/tampered and rerun 434 tests.

[1/4] Plan: authenticate a keyed claim store through verify_claim_store

impact_assessment.why: The combined verifier loaded keyed claim snapshots without passing the store key, silently bypassing the new MAC.
impact_assessment.benefits: store_hmac_key authenticates the snapshot through the combined verifier; wrong keys raise; the unkeyed path stays compatible.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: one optional verifier kwarg; dependency: claims_store load; concurrency: read-only; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Pass the key to load_ledger, report store_hmac, test correct/wrong/unkeyed, and rerun 435 tests plus AIKit.

[1/4] Plan: stream header-only reads for episode/claim verification

impact_assessment.why: Verification parsed and retained every action record just to find headers; a 100k-record log cost 124.2 MB peak.
impact_assessment.benefits: read_headers retains only headers; measured 0.1 MB peak vs 124.2 MB and 4.019 s vs 5.715 s, with identical results and errors.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: additive Telemetry method; dependency: none; concurrency: read-only; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Match read_all whitespace/JSON behavior, add tests and a 100k battery, use it in both verifiers, rerun 438 tests plus AIKit.
